summary: Existence of a Hecke character with prescribed infinity type and tame part reduces to a compatibility on the global units of norm one, which are roots of unity ζ^k; there the infinite factors and ω^n cancel because the orders divide M_ω and the weights are adapted.

steps.claim: By exists_hasWeight_of_prod_eq_one (with the finite set of chosen places, outside which ω^n is trivial), it suffices that for every global norm-one unit u (integral, U) the product of the infinity-type factors u^{−a·w₀} and of ω^n(u mod w) over the chosen places is 1.
steps.lean: exists_hasWeight_of_prod_eq_one (S := D.finite_isChosen.toFinset) (by aesop) fun ⟨_, _⟩ U ↦ by

steps.claim: Such a unit is a root of unity of E, hence a power ζ^k of the chosen primitive root ζ of order N₁.

For u = ζ^k (ζ^{N₁} = 1): the tame factors are 1, because ω_w = T_w^{M_ω} with T_w the chosen residue character of order M_ω², so ω_w(ζ^k)^n = T_w(ζ^{k·n·M_ω}) = T_w(1) = 1, as N₁ ∣ N₁·d ∣ M_ω (N₁_mul_d_dvd_M_omega) — not because of the order of ω_w(ζ). In the infinity factors Φ_v(ζ^k)^{−a·w₀(v)}, w₀(v) = b₁ or b₂ (thick or not) + h₂, and b₁, b₂ are multiples of N₁ (D.roundUp), so they drop out and every place carries the same exponent −a·k·h₂; what remains is a power of ∏_v Φ_v(ζ), treated in step 4.
steps.lean:
simp_all [↓← map_pow, w, b₁, b₂, ω, prod_eq_one, ↓zpow_mul, ↓zpow_natCast, pow_add, roundUp,
    pow_mul, pow_right_comm, ← Submonoid.one_def, pow_apply', ne, pow_right_comm _ _ D.N₁,
    isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.1, ↓inv_pow, pow_eq_pow_of_modEq N₁_mul_d_dvd_M_omega.modEq_zero_nat]

steps.claim: The remaining factor is the norm of ζ, which is 1 (N₁ ≠ 2, cyclotomic polynomial irreducible).
